answer: Require every joining agent to lock an escrowed deposit before it can act. New identities start at a reputation nadir and climb only by completing verified work, so trust forms a terrace: each tier unlocks a bit more influence. Crossing that bridge from unknown to trusted costs real time and locked capital. A sybil swarm must fund one deposit per fake, wait out every terrace, and risk having all deposits slashed at once if collusion is detected, which makes the attack economically pointless.
